analysis.one_line_summary: In a hair salon, a hairdresser hands a pink WavyTalk thermal round brush to a client to demonstrate how she styles her hair strand.
analysis.full_description: A hairdresser standing behind a young female client in a hair salon hands her a pink WavyTalk thermal styling brush and asks her to show how she curls a strand of hair. The video cuts to a close-up of her winding a hair section around the bristle barrel, then cuts back to the hairdresser taking control of the section and telling her he will show her the proper technique.

scenes.visual: Medium shot of the client smiling while holding the brush as the hairdresser takes the hair section to correct her technique.
scenes.action: The hairdresser holds her strand of hair outwards and tells her he will show her how to properly style it.
